name: M.Tech. in Power Systems

outcomes.text: Students will build strong theoretical foundation in order to understand, assess and analyse the complexities involved in power systems and to optimise for efficient operation, and planning of the power system.
Students get well acquainted with the state-of-the-art industrial practices in smart grids and orient themselves with the needs of the industry including sustainability.

Students will be able to effectively communicate their ideas to society in the form of technical/scientific reports and impactful presentations, work independently as well as in multidisciplinary teams, and provide ethical, environmentally sustainable solutions to engineering problems
